input: I live at Barchman Wuytierslaan 20 in Amersfoort. What year was this building built? What's the energy label and floor area? Answer with only a JSON object with the keys "year_built", "energy_label" and "floor_area_m2". Use null for a value that is not registered.

metadata.hypothesis: The answer needs two registrations: the BAG for the building year and floor area, EP-Online for the energy label. EP-Online has no label for this address, so the right energy_label is null. A model without tools can only guess. Likely failure: an invented label, or the label of another address, such as Barchman Wuytierslaan 2. EP-Online shows a result only after a POST of its search form, which a fetch by GET cannot do, so an agent may not tell 'no label' from 'not found'
